balanced_ensemble.description: Equal weighting of all available models

confidence_weighted.description: Weight models by their training accuracy (example)
confidence_weighted.notes: Update weights based on validation performance

miniBatchSize.description: Number of images to process before sending intermediate results
miniBatchSize.notes: Lower values = more responsive UX but slower overall. Higher values = faster batch processing.

lazyLoad.description: Unload models from memory after use to save VRAM
lazyLoad.notes: Enable when using multiple large models. Disable for faster repeated classifications.

weights.description: Relative weights for each classifier (must match classifiers array length)
weights.notes: Weights are automatically normalized to sum to 1.0. Higher weight = more influence on final score.

usage.browser_extension: Send 'model' object in payload with desired configuration
